task: Build stopwatch widget with spawn functionality
summary: Built a stopwatch widget with spawn functionality. Users can click a + button to create multiple independent stopwatches, each with start/stop/reset controls. State persists across page reloads via localStorage.

features_implemented: Floating + button to spawn new stopwatches
Running timers resume after page reload
details.design_system: C3.ai-inspired Iron Man HUD theme (glassmorphism, cyan accents)

changes: Added stopwatch container HTML after HUD corners
Added stopwatchManager JavaScript object with full state management
Methods: spawn, start, stop, toggle, reset, remove, saveState, restoreState
Added ~250 lines of stopwatch widget styles
Floating spawn button with hover animation

handoff_notes: The stopwatch widget is purely frontend - no backend API needed. State is stored in localStorage under key 'ihim_stopwatches'. Widget appears in top-right corner of iHIM dashboard. CSS follows existing HUD/Iron Man theme with glassmorphism effects. No backend coordination required.
